resources.string: Babu maɓallin API tukuna — danna “Maɓalli” don ƙara ɗaya.
Wannan samfurin ba ya samuwa ga maɓallinka. Zaɓi wani daga jerin.
Duba maɓallin API, sannan sunan samfurin.
An ƙi maɓallin. Danna “Maɓalli” ka yi amfani da “Ajiye kuma tabbatar” don ganin dalili.
An iyakance yawan buƙatu — jira kaɗan ka sake gwadawa.
Ɓangaren Google yana kasawa yanzu. Sake gwadawa yakan yi aiki.
Amsa mara komai — mai yiwuwa an kashe kasafin fitarwa a tunani na ciki. Sake gwadawa ko sake tsara tambayar.
Google ya ƙi wannan maɓallin (HTTP %1$d).%2$s\n\nSau da yawa an soke shi, na aikin da aka kashe Generative Language API ne, ko kuma an kwafe shi bai cika ba.
An kasa isa ga Google don duba maɓallin: %1$s
Wannan adireshin yanar gizo ne, ba maɓalli ba. Buɗe shi sannan ka kwafe maɓallin da ya nuna.
Wannan yayi kama da maɓallin OpenAI. Wannan mataimakin yana amfani da Google Gemini; sami maɓalli a aistudio.google.com.
Maɓallin ya yi kama da yankakke a haruffa %1$d. Duba ko an kwafe shi duka.
